verdict.rationale: Published pricing is a fair question for an observability product, but the evidence pack contains no pricing page, per-signal rates, or self-serve cost calculator. The only cost references are about technical cost efficiency: time series data streams keeping storage costs predictable, and tiered storage. These are adjacent product features, not transparent published pricing.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can predict costs from transparent published per-signal pricing without talking to sales
